title.en: Import an API key you have already set up
title.zh: 一键导入已有的 API 密钥

description.en: Agent setup can fill in a key this computer already has — from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI and other tools, from your shell environment, or from another agent configured here — or read one from a pasted configuration. Only keys the agent can use are listed, and they never leave this computer.
description.zh: 配置智能体时，可直接填入本机已有的密钥：来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Gemini CLI 等工具，Shell 环境变量，或启动器中已配置的其他智能体；也可粘贴一段配置自动识别。仅列出该智能体可用的密钥，密钥不会离开本机。

title.en: OpenCode can use its own sign-in
title.zh: OpenCode 支持直接使用自身登录

description.en: An OpenCode signed in with `opencode auth login`, or running OpenCode Zen's free models, no longer needs an API key entered in the launcher. Choose a model from those your sign-in can run.
description.zh: 已通过 `opencode auth login` 登录，或使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型的 OpenCode，无需再在启动器中填写 API 密钥，直接从登录后可用的模型中选择即可。
